title: Onward Tickets for Residents in Saudi Arabia: What You Need
metaTitle: Onward Tickets for Residents in Saudi Arabia: Guide

content:
Two separate things happen when you live in the Kingdom on an iqama and plan a trip abroad. Your visa file at the application centre in Riyadh, Jeddah or Al Khobar asks for a flight reservation, and the check-in agent at King Khalid or King Abdulaziz wants to see onward travel before boarding you on a one-way booking. One unticketed reservation carrying a real six-character PNR covers both jobs, and in riyals it starts at SAR 49.

What is an onward ticket and why do residents in Saudi Arabia need one?

An onward ticket is proof that you will leave the country you are flying into. It is a flight reservation held in an airline reservation system, showing your name, a route out of that country and a date.

Expat residents hit this more often than most travellers because so many trips out of the Kingdom are one-way or open-ended. You fly to Manila, Lahore, Dhaka, Cairo or Khartoum on a single ticket because you do not yet know when leave ends, and the agent at the desk asks how you plan to get out again.

Our onward ticket is an unticketed reservation created on Amadeus, Sabre or Travelport. It carries a live PNR, it arrives by email in minutes, and it is built for exactly this moment at the desk.

Does my iqama or my passport decide what I need?

Your iqama governs your life inside the Kingdom and your passport governs what the destination asks of you. The iqama is what lets you work, open a bank account and come back after a trip. It carries no weight at all with an immigration officer in Bangkok or a visa officer in Lisbon.

That split catches people out. An Indian or Pakistani passport holder living in Jeddah for twelve years is still, to the Schengen area or the UK, an Indian or Pakistani national applying for a visa. The iqama helps the file because it shows settled residence and income, but it does not reduce what the destination requires.

A worked example helps. A Filipino nurse with eight years on an iqama in Al Khobar applying for a Schengen visa is assessed as a Filipino national, with the iqama and the employer letter acting as evidence that she is settled and will return. The strength of the file comes from the residence, while the document list comes from the passport.

So read the destination's rules against your passport, not against your residence. Then read your exit and re-entry formalities against your iqama.

Where do Schengen visa applications from Saudi Arabia get filed?

Schengen applications from residents of the Kingdom go through VFS Global centres. The Dutch government's own guidance tells applicants to go to the VFS Global centre in Al Khobar, Dhahran, Jeddah or Riyadh, and adds that you can only apply there if you live in Saudi Arabia.

Which country's mission handles you depends on your main destination, but the centre and the paperwork pattern are much the same across them. Book the appointment early, because slots in Riyadh and Jeddah fill up in the run-up to summer and Eid.

Each mission publishes its own checklist, so read the one for the country you are actually visiting. Our guide to a dummy ticket for a Schengen visa walks through how the reservation fits into that file.

What does a Schengen checklist ask residents for?

The checklists ask for a flight reservation, not a paid ticket. The Portugal checklist for applications submitted in the Kingdom lists "Flight/travel reservations, including return flight", and includes internal Schengen flights, trains or buses where they apply.

That same checklist has two items aimed only at non-Saudi applicants, and they are the ones residents forget. It asks for your iqama valid at least three months after the planned return, plus a copy, and for your Saudi Arabian re-entry visa valid beyond your intended return from the Schengen area, plus a copy. The Dutch checklist used in Saudi Arabia asks for the same two things.

Check your iqama expiry date before you book the appointment. If it runs out six weeks after your planned return, the file is short of a requirement no reservation can fix.

The rest of the list is yours to gather: accommodation proof, bank statements covering six months for non-Saudi nationals, an employer letter stamped and attested, and travel medical insurance for the Schengen area with minimum cover of EUR 30,000 including repatriation. The Portugal checklist also states that applications are decided within 15 calendar days and can be lodged at the earliest three months before the trip. We supply the flight reservation and nothing else on that list. Travel insurance we can arrange by email on request.

Does a UK visa application from Saudi Arabia need a flight booking?

No, and the Home Office says so plainly. The gov.uk guidance on documents you must provide as a Standard Visitor names the passport as the document you must have, and asks you to show that you will leave at the end of the visit and that "you're able to pay for your return or onward journey". It does not ask for a ticket.

That is about ability to pay, not about a booking. Plenty of applicants still attach a reservation because it makes the travel dates in the online form match a document in the file, which is reasonable, but it is not on the required list.

If you hold an Indian, Pakistani, Bangladeshi, Filipino, Egyptian or Sudanese passport, check what you need against your nationality using the official gov.uk visa checker. Residence in the Kingdom does not change the answer.

Will the check-in agent in Riyadh or Jeddah ask for onward travel?

Often, yes, if you are travelling on a one-way booking to a country that expects onward travel. The airline carries the cost when a passenger is refused entry and sent back, so the desk screens for it before you board.

A reservation on screen is usually what settles it. The agent wants a route out of the destination within the permitted stay, in your name, that looks like a real booking because it is one. We have a full walkthrough of using a dummy ticket at airport check-in, and a separate piece on what documents prove onward travel to immigration.

Carry it on your phone and keep a printout in your hand luggage. Desks in the Kingdom get busy around flight waves, and the version you can show in five seconds is the one that keeps the queue moving.

How does anyone verify the reservation?

Verification runs through the global distribution systems first. An embassy, a visa centre or an airline agent takes the six-character PNR and looks it up in Amadeus, Sabre or Travelport, which is where the booking actually lives.

Here is the part worth knowing before you travel. Most airlines display only ticketed bookings on their own website, so a live unticketed reservation often will not show up in a "manage my booking" box even while it is perfectly valid in the GDS. Emirates and Etihad are the usual exceptions where it does appear.

That difference causes needless panic. If you want the detail, read how embassies verify flight reservations through GDS, which explains what a verifying officer is looking at and why the airline site is the wrong place to check.

Can a border officer phone the airline to check?

It is rare, and the lookup anyone trusts is the system record rather than a phone call. An officer at a border post works from passenger data and, where they want to confirm a booking, the reservation system is the authoritative place to look.

What this means for you is simple. A reservation with a genuine PNR holds up to a check, and a screenshot of something that was never in a reservation system does not. We go into the detail in our piece on whether border officers can call airlines to verify tickets.

What about my exit and re-entry visa?

That is a Jawazat matter, handled through Absher, and it sits outside anything we sell. Exit and re-entry permission is issued for a resident through the Absher platform, and the rules around validity, fees and extensions change, so take them from Absher or your sponsor rather than from a blog.

We make no claim that our reservation satisfies any Jawazat or government requirement for leaving or returning to the Kingdom. What it does is serve the airline at the desk and the flight-reservation line on a visa checklist.

One practical link between the two: the Schengen checklists want your re-entry visa to stay valid beyond your return date from Europe. Sort the Absher side first, then build the visa file around those dates.

What does a flight reservation cost in Saudi Arabia?

Three validity options, priced in riyals on our Saudi Arabia page:

  • SAR 49 for a 2 day reservation, or USD 13
  • SAR 69 for a 7 day reservation, or USD 19
  • SAR 79 for a 14 day reservation, or USD 21

Pick the length by how long the document has to stand up. A reservation shown at the check-in desk only needs to be live on the day you fly, so the 2 day option is enough.

A visa file is different. The paperwork sits with the mission for days or weeks, so a 7 or 14 day reservation gives the officer a booking that is still live when they open it.

How do you order one?

Fill in the route, dates and the passenger name exactly as it appears in your passport. Not as it appears on your iqama, and not a shortened version you use at work.

Pay, and the reservation lands in your inbox within minutes with its six-character PNR. Check the spelling of the name and the dates the moment it arrives, while there is still time to fix anything before your appointment or your flight.

Two more habits save trouble. Book the appointment before you order the reservation, so the dates on the form, the reservation and the appointment slot all agree, and keep the confirmation email rather than only a screenshot of it.

If a trip slips, order a fresh reservation for the new dates instead of trying to explain an old one. At SAR 49 for the short option that costs less than a refused application or a missed flight. Start with the riyal pricing page, or read more about how an onward ticket works at the desk.

A short checklist before you fly out

Confirm your iqama has enough validity left for the destination's rules, and confirm your exit and re-entry status on Absher. Those two belong to you and your sponsor, and no document from us replaces them.

Then read the checklist published by the mission you are applying to, against your passport nationality. Order the reservation last, when your dates are settled, so the booking in the file matches the dates on the form.

faqs.question: Can I use my iqama instead of a flight reservation?
faqs.answer: No. Your iqama proves residence in Saudi Arabia and supports a visa file, but it says nothing about how you leave the country you are flying into. Schengen checklists used in the Kingdom ask for a flight reservation and a copy of the iqama as two separate items.

faqs.question: Will my reservation show on the airline's website?
faqs.answer: Usually not. Most airlines display only ticketed bookings on their own site, so a live unticketed reservation often will not appear in a manage-booking page even though it is valid. Emirates and Etihad are the usual exceptions. Verification runs through Amadeus, Sabre or Travelport instead.

faqs.question: How long does delivery take?
faqs.answer: Minutes. The reservation is created in Amadeus, Sabre or Travelport and emailed to you with its six-character booking reference. Check the passenger name against your passport and check the dates as soon as it lands, so anything wrong can be fixed before your appointment or departure.

faqs.question: Which validity should I buy for a visa appointment?
faqs.answer: Pick 7 or 14 days for a visa file, because the paperwork sits with the mission after you submit it and the booking should still be live when an officer opens it. The 2 day option suits a reservation you only need to show at the check-in desk.

faqs.question: Does the reservation help with my exit and re-entry visa?
faqs.answer: No. Exit and re-entry permission is a Jawazat matter handled through Absher, and we make no claim that our reservation meets any government requirement there. Our reservation serves the airline at check-in and the flight-reservation line on a visa checklist. Check Absher for the current rules.

faqs.question: Do I need a flight booking for a UK visa from Saudi Arabia?
faqs.answer: Not as a required document. The gov.uk Standard Visitor guidance names your passport and asks you to show you can pay for a return or onward journey, which is about funds rather than a booking. Many applicants still attach a reservation to match their stated dates.
